classification.difficultyReason: Identify all supported classifications from supplied side and angle properties using the taught inclusive hierarchy.

content.prompt:
Identify the quadrilateral using its angle properties.
Circle ALL of the shapes the quadrilaterals could be classified as.

spec.description: Sideways kite with both left sides labelled 10 cm, both right sides labelled 17 cm, matching purple upper and lower angle arcs, and unnumbered left and right angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: Two pairs of equal adjacent sides; upper and lower opposite angles are equal. Coordinates preserve the side-length ratio without printing additional measurements.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and angle markings are visible.

answer.worked:
The shape has four sides and two pairs of equal adjacent sides: $10\text{ cm},10\text{ cm}$ and $17\text{ cm},17\text{ cm}$. The equal opposite angles agree with the kite properties.
Correct answer: Quadrilateral and Kite.

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with four right-angle squares, double ticks on top and bottom, and single ticks on left and right.
spec.mathematics: Four right angles and two opposite-side equality families.
spec.answerVisibility: No classification answer is printed in the figure.

answer.worked:
Four right angles identify a rectangle. Its opposite sides are parallel, so it is also a parallelogram. Under the taught inclusive definition, having at least one pair of parallel sides also makes it a trapezium. It has four sides, so it is a quadrilateral.
Correct answer: Quadrilateral, Trapezium, Parallelogram and Rectangle.

spec.description: Irregular quadrilateral with clockwise angles 70°, 133°, 65°, 92° and clockwise side labels 16 cm, 4.2 cm, 16.6 cm, 9 cm. The 65° label remains outside the figure.
spec.mathematics: The four supplied interior angles sum to 360°. No pair of opposite sides is supported as parallel, and all four stated lengths differ. Source measurements are retained at their stated precision.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements and angle markings are visible.

answer.worked:
The shape has four sides. No adjacent-angle pair sums to $180^\circ$, so there is no parallel opposite-side pair. The stated side lengths are all different, and none of the angles is a right angle.
Correct answer: Quadrilateral.

spec.description: Trapezium with horizontal top and bottom edges and interior angles 124°, 110°, 70°, 56° in clockwise order from upper left. No parallel arrows are added.
spec.mathematics: The angles on each sloping side sum to 180°, establishing the horizontal sides as parallel. Coordinates derive the sloping sides from the supplied lower angles.
spec.answerVisibility: The figure contains source angle givens only.

answer.worked:
$124^\circ+56^\circ=180^\circ$ and $110^\circ+70^\circ=180^\circ$. These supplementary co-interior angles establish that the top and bottom sides are parallel. The shape has four sides and one parallel opposite-side pair.
Correct answer: Quadrilateral and Trapezium.
